summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing minutes of its Fiscal Council meeting held July 27, 2026. The agenda covered presentations on tax/regulatory/civil/labor contingencies; the company's Quarterly Information Report (ITRs) for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026; and a presentation by independent auditor Ernst & Young on the ITRs. No irregularities or reservations were identified. This is a routine compliance filing with no special-situation transaction, merger, activist campaign, or other extraordinary corporate event disclosed. It is equivalent to a current report on Form 6-K for a foreign private issuer's standard board/committee update.
